salary_basis: EU Blue Card general threshold; shortage occupations approx 43759
language_requirement: B1 for regulated trades and care; none for Blue Card
recognition_regime: Formal recognition required for regulated professions; Anerkennung process for trades and health
recognition_note: Nurses need Berufsanerkennung plus B2 German; Skilled Immigration Act allows recognition partnership on arrival
key_requirements: Blue Card, Skilled Workers (vocational qualification recognised), Opportunity Card points system, Western Balkans quota

salary_basis: Blue Card threshold approx 1.5x average gross salary
recognition_regime: ADECRI/ARS recognition for health; commission for regulated trades
recognition_note: Nurses require ARS authorisation and French language proof
key_requirements: Passeport Talent (multiple sub-routes), salarie en mission, seasonal, shortage occupation list by region

salary_basis: Decreto Flussi quota-based; salary at national collective agreement level
recognition_regime: Regulated professions need Ministry of Health or MIUR recognition
recognition_note: Nurses need Ministry of Health recognition; long queues reported
key_requirements: Decreto Flussi annual quota with preferential country list, seasonal agriculture and tourism, nulla osta from employer

salary_basis: Blue Card at 1.5x average; GECCO seasonal at collective agreement rate
recognition_regime: Homologacion required for regulated professions; slow for health
recognition_note: GECCO circular migration is the highest-volume African route and needs no qualification recognition
key_requirements: GECCO seasonal (Morocco), arraigo routes, catalogo de ocupaciones de dificil cobertura

salary_basis: Highly Skilled Migrant monthly gross: approx 5688 over 30, 4171 under 30
language_requirement: None for HSM; Dutch for BIG health register
recognition_regime: BIG registration for health; Nuffic credential evaluation
recognition_note: Recognised sponsor employer required for the HSM route
key_requirements: Highly Skilled Migrant (recognised sponsor), EU Blue Card, orientation year for graduates

salary_basis: Single permit high-skilled threshold varies by region (Flanders/Wallonia/Brussels)
language_requirement: Regional: Dutch or French for some roles
recognition_regime: Regional recognition (NARIC Vlaanderen / Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles)
recognition_note: Three regional regimes with different thresholds and shortage lists
key_requirements: Single Permit, EU Blue Card, regional shortage occupation lists

salary_basis: Maintenance requirement approx 80 percent of median salary
recognition_regime: Socialstyrelsen for health; UHR for academic credentials
recognition_note: Work permit requires union-agreed terms and advertised vacancy in EU
key_requirements: Work permit tied to employer offer, EU advertising requirement, no quota

salary_basis: National minimum wage for most permits; Blue Card at 1.5x average
recognition_regime: Ministry of Health for medical; NAWA for academic
recognition_note: Employer declaration route is fast and high volume but dominated by Eastern European nationals
key_requirements: Employer declaration (oswiadczenie), work permit types A-E, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: Minimum wage baseline; CPLP routes have lighter requirements
recognition_regime: Recognition through DGES for academic; Ordem for regulated
recognition_note: CPLP mobility agreement gives Lusophone African nationals a materially easier route
key_requirements: CPLP Mobility Agreement, job-seeker visa, highly qualified activity visa

salary_basis: Critical Skills threshold 38000 general / 34000 for shortage list roles
recognition_regime: NMBI for nurses; QQI for academic recognition
recognition_note: Outside Schengen so no Schengen visa data; separate Irish visa system
key_requirements: Critical Skills Employment Permit, General Employment Permit, ineligible occupations list

salary_basis: Key Employee Initiative approx 35000
recognition_regime: Recognition via MFHEA; health via Council for Nurses
recognition_note: English-language labour market is unusually accessible for anglophone African origins
key_requirements: Key Employee Initiative, Single Permit, Specialist Employee Initiative

salary_basis: Red-White-Red Card points system with salary minimums by category
recognition_regime: Recognition via ENIC NARIC Austria; health via provincial authority
recognition_note: Points system rewards German language heavily, disadvantaging non-German-speaking origins
key_requirements: Red-White-Red Card (several categories), shortage occupation list, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: Pay Limit Scheme approx 514000 DKK per year
recognition_regime: Danish Agency for Higher Education; health via Patient Safety Authority
recognition_note: High absolute salary threshold makes lower-wage sectors effectively closed
key_requirements: Pay Limit Scheme, Positive List for higher and skilled education, Fast Track

salary_basis: Sector collective agreement minimum
language_requirement: Finnish or Swedish for care and health
recognition_regime: Valvira for health professionals; ENIC NARIC Finland
recognition_note: Certified employer scheme speeds processing
key_requirements: Residence permit for employed person, EU Blue Card, specialist permit

salary_basis: Employee Card at collective agreement level
recognition_regime: Ministry of Education nostrification; slow for some origins
recognition_note: Nostrification of foreign diplomas is a documented bottleneck
key_requirements: Employee Card, EU Blue Card, government skilled worker programmes with country quotas

salary_basis: No quota since 2021; salary at collective agreement
recognition_regime: Recognition via ENIC NARIC Croatia
recognition_note: Quota system abolished in 2021, making entry structurally easier
key_requirements: Stay and work permit (no quota), seasonal work, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: Collective agreement minimum; seasonal at agricultural rate
recognition_regime: DOATAP for academic recognition
recognition_note: Bilateral seasonal agreement with Egypt is the model African route
key_requirements: Seasonal agricultural work, bilateral agreement routes, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: Average gross salary basis; quota set annually
recognition_regime: CNRED for academic recognition
recognition_note: Annual quota has expanded substantially and is under-subscribed
key_requirements: Work permit within annual quota, EU Blue Card, seconded worker

salary_basis: Guest worker regime with employer sponsorship
recognition_regime: Hungarian Equivalence and Information Centre
recognition_note: Guest Worker Act restricts eligible nationalities by government decree
key_requirements: Guest worker permit, EU Blue Card, seasonal

salary_basis: Average salary for the position
recognition_regime: NACID for academic recognition
recognition_note: Blue Card threshold lowered to attract third-country nationals
key_requirements: EU Blue Card, single permit, seasonal work up to 90 days

salary_basis: Comparable local salary
recognition_regime: Ministry of Education recognition
recognition_note: Shortage occupation districts allow faster processing
key_requirements: Single permit, shortage occupation route, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: Comparable local salary
recognition_regime: ENIC NARIC Slovenia
recognition_note: Western Balkans bilateral agreements dominate inflows
key_requirements: Single permit, EU Blue Card, seasonal

salary_basis: Average gross salary; 1.5x for Blue Card
recognition_regime: SKVC for academic recognition
recognition_note: Shortage occupation list allows bypassing labour market test
key_requirements: Shortage occupation route, EU Blue Card, temporary residence for work

salary_basis: Average salary basis
recognition_regime: AIC for academic recognition
recognition_note: Small labour market with limited third-country intake
key_requirements: Work visa and residence permit, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: 1.0-1.24x Estonian average wage; annual immigration quota
language_requirement: Estonian or English depending on role
recognition_regime: Estonian ENIC NARIC
recognition_note: Annual immigration quota of 0.1 percent of population is a hard ceiling
key_requirements: Short-term employment registration, EU Blue Card, quota-bound residence permit

salary_basis: Blue Card at 1.5x average; high absolute levels
language_requirement: French or German for many roles
recognition_regime: Ministry of Education recognition
recognition_note: Small market; multilingual requirements are a real barrier
key_requirements: Salaried worker authorisation, EU Blue Card

salary_basis: Collective agreement minimum
recognition_regime: KYSATS for academic recognition
recognition_note: Not in Schengen visa area for short stays; separate national visa
key_requirements: Employment permit, seasonal agricultural workers, EU Blue Card
